div.p:
Poems, stories, and things
I didn’t say out loud.
div.span:
A little ink.
A little infinity.

div.p: Short things that would not stay quiet. Written in two languages, sometimes in the same breath.
Longer walks. People who are almost real, and rooms that almost existed.
Thinking out loud, slowly — on reading, work, cities and the ordinary days in between.
The pages I would hand to a stranger first.
Small films and visual notes, kept alongside the words.

div.span: An open bottle. An unfinished story.
